notes: Source: user-supplied file '52_Vehicle_proverbs_and_sayings' (61 rows despite the filename). Columns B–F of Master_Dataset are copied verbatim from that file (escape backslashes removed only).
Original_Translation is never overwritten. Corrections appear in Normalized_Translation and are flagged in Human_Review.
Multi-label fields use '|' as separator. 'Not evident' = no textual basis; it is not a negative finding.
Code_Matrix, Frequencies and Co_occurrence are formula-driven from the Codes column: edit Codes and they recalculate.
Confidence: High = explicit; Medium = needs contextual inference; Low = several readings plausible.
Power_Hierarchy uses: Reproduction / Reflection / Critique / Resistance / Ambiguous (master prompt §10).
Coding is a first pass by Claude, not a validated annotation. All entries flagged Y need native-speaker review before publication.
